name: scevm-chat
description: Route VS Code Chat through SC-EVM with approved context, diagnostics, and bounded workspace-edit loops.

commands.title: SC-EVM: Review and Apply Pending Edit

chatParticipants.name: scevm
chatParticipants.description: Session-isolated development assistant backed by Nemotron and GPT-OSS.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Check the local gateway and active session

commands.name: new
commands.description: Burn the current session and start a fresh one

commands.name: diagnose
commands.description: Verify gateway, pipeline, session, and execution settings

commands.name: review
commands.description: Inspect approved workspace files and produce an evidence-backed plan

scevm.gatewayUrl.description: SC-EVM FastAPI gateway. Non-loopback URLs require explicit opt-in.

scevm.allowRemoteGateway.description: Allow sending prompts and approved context to a non-loopback gateway.

scevm.contextPolicy.description: How active-editor context is shared. Chat attachments are always treated as explicitly approved.

scevm.maxContextBytes.description: Maximum total UTF-8 bytes sent as workspace context per request.

scevm.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum duration for one streamed SC-EVM request.

scevm.graphifyEnabled.description: Enable gateway-local Graphify context only when its index matches the active VS Code workspace.

scevm.executionMode.description: Confirm once per request and apply bounded workspace edits automatically, or review each edit separately.

scevm.maxAgentIterations.description: Maximum M1 to M2 requests in one confirmed workspace-edit loop.

scevm.developmentPhase.description: Session phase gate: 0 initialization, 1 database design, 2 backend ready, 3 UI ready.

scripts.package: npm run check && npm test && vsce package --no-dependencies
